chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He said: Preserve your books, for you will have need of them.

key_terms.تَحْتَاجُونَ: You will need / Have need of

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about preserving books?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises the preservation of books, indicating their enduring utility and importance for future reference and study. This narration highlights the value of written knowledge in Islamic tradition.
